description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'AccessStrategy' within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. The class serves as a base for implementing various access control strategies related to maintenance functionalities, providing methods for parameter management, entity data retrieval, and value formatting. It interacts with the MaintenanceService and establishes a structure for access-related logic that will be extended by subclasses.

classes.name: AccessStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class providing a blueprint for different access control strategies in the maintenance module, supporting entity data access, parameter handling, and value formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the access strategy with an entity class name and configuration array, setting up match criteria and parameters.

methods.name: access
methods.description: An abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, defining how access is granted based on employee number.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the configured parameters for the access strategy.

methods.name: setParameters
methods.description: Sets the parameters used in the access strategy.

methods.name: getEntityClassName
methods.description: Retrieves the class name of the entity associated with this access strategy.

methods.name: setEntityClassName
methods.description: Assigns the entity class name for the access strategy.

methods.name: getMatchBy
methods.description: Returns the array defining the matching criteria.

methods.name: getMaintenanceService
methods.description: Provides access to the MaintenanceService, creating it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getMatchByValues
methods.description: Constructs an array of match criteria based on employee number for entity queries.

methods.name: getEntityRecords
methods.description: Retrieves entity records matching the given criteria from the maintenance service.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Dynamically formats a value using a specified formatter class.

methods.name: addRecordsToArray
methods.description: Transforms an access entity into an associative array based on configured parameters, applying formatting as needed.
